text:
jess: :rotating_light: Heads-up — we're seeing a multi-tenant read surge against the embeddings store in us-west-2 causing elevated 500s and increased tail latency for embedding lookups. Investigating now. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1893456789

matt: Observed a spike in read QPS from 03:12 UTC, mostly small requests from the new vector-cache rollout. Error rate up to ~18% on embed-store-read path.

sre-oncall: Oncall here. Initial triage: IO stall on SSD pool node group embed-store-3 (io_wait high). Scaling didn't help because requests were saturating file-descriptor queues.

carla: Customers impacted: a handful of mid-market apps using dense-retrieval. Support flagged two paying customers with session errors here: ticket #PR-4321 and #PR-4328.

support-runner: I've messaged both PMs and opened support incidents, sharing temporary mitigation steps. They want ETA and workaround.

infra-bot: Auto-scaling attempted 03:17 UTC -> 3 extra pods started, but eviction/backpressure triggered because underlying block device had rising latencies.

jess: Mitigation applied: enabled per-tenant read throttles for embeddings (soft cap 1200 rps) + routed heavy tenants to degraded but stable cold-embed service. Patch rolled to prod at 03:28 UTC.

matt: Quick log snippet showing fd queue growth before throttling:
```
[03:15:12] embed-store-3 fd_pending=842 backlog=1200 iowait=78%
[03:16:05] embed-store-3 fd_pending=1203 backlog=1500 iowait=92%
[03:17:30] embed-store-3 throttling=initiated
```

sre-oncall: Current status: error-rate dropped from 18% -> 3.6% after throttles and cold fallback. Latency p95 reduced from ~1.9s -> ~420ms. Rolling restart of embed-store-3 scheduled to clear kernel-level resource pressure (03:45 UTC).

carla: Noting customer comms: crafting brief to impacted accounts summarizing cause and steps. Will include suggested client retry/backoff config.

jess: Postmortem owner: matt. Short-term follow-ups: 1) expand read queue visibility in perf dashboard, 2) add per-node fd alerts, 3) increase cold-embed capacity for fallbacks.

support-runner: ETA for full recovery?

sre-oncall: Full recovery expected after rolling restart + IO remediation — target 04:10 UTC. Will update status page and ping on this thread.

incident-bot: Update posted to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1893456789 (current status: partial mitigation, customer-impact reduced).

jess: Action items assigned in the runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/embed-store-read-surge. If you have capacity, please help validate client retry behaviors and run the smoke test matrix on staging-tenants.

matt: Will own PM follow-ups and long-term fixes (kernel tuning + storage IO upgrades). Starting the post-incident notes now.

carla: Support note: sent proactive messages to impacted customers with workaround and ETA. Slack thread with account teams: #sales-urgent.

sre-oncall: Rolling restart in progress 03:47 UTC -> embed-store-3 offline 03:49 UTC, back online 03:55 UTC; monitoring.

matt: Verified p99 and p95 are back in normal range. Marking as "mitigated" on internal timeline, will move to resolved after 2 hours of stability.

jess: Thanks all. Please avoid large manual flushes against embeddings until we finish the storage follow-ups. Will post final resolution update once we hit the stability window. :white_check_mark:
